observed_effect: Generation text was byte-for-byte identical across v1/v2, but 25 M0 GSM8K parsed answers and 19 correctness outcomes changed under the flawed v2 parser.
recovery_rule: Do not reinterpret SF-MODEL-v2 in place. Freeze v2 raw prediction hashes and corrected evaluator under SF-MODEL-v3, then re-score exact immutable outputs against raw references.
